finding.summary: The generic Actor proxy envelope did not guarantee the sessionId required by n8n Simple Memory.
finding.observed_error: Error in sub-node Simple Memory: No session ID found
finding.remediation: Normalize every Actor request at the n8n adapter boundary to include action, a tenant/user/twin-bound opaque sessionId and chatInput, independent of the calling backend route. Invalid IDs, malformed text, missing scope and missing correlation fail before n8n dispatch.
